paragraphs: The concert has been moved to the cathedral because of the heavy rain forecast for
tonight. Please keep your ticket until the end of the journey, as inspectors may ask to see
it. In winter the lake freezes and people skate across it to the island in the middle.
The exhibition shows how the town grew from a fishing village into a busy trading port.
Visitors can climb the tower for a wide view over the river and the rooftops. A free shuttle
bus runs between the hotel and the beach every half hour.
By the time the sun rose, the ship was already far from the harbour. Swimming is not
allowed when the red flag is raised on the beach. The library holds rare maps, letters and
diaries written by the first settlers of the island.
Trains to the airport leave every twenty minutes from the second platform. The market
sells spices, dried fruit, olives and cheese made by local shepherds.
The theatre was restored last year and now seats almost nine hundred people. Every room
has a view of the mountains and a balcony facing the morning sun. Nobody remembered
exactly when the old clock in the square had stopped working.
Local craftsmen still weave carpets by hand using patterns passed down for generations.
Our kitchen uses fresh vegetables from farms in the valley whenever the season allows.
They walked along the shore, talking about the journey that lay ahead of them.
